ALTER procedure [dbo].[pro_get_combo_by_branch] @vstatus nvarchar(50), @vBranchcode NVARCHAR(100), @vCon1 NVARCHAR(100)='' AS BEGIN
IF (@vstatus='Active')BEGIN
SELECT DISTINCT A.con_id AS code, A.con_display AS title FROM sysconstants AS A WHERE A.con_line='Active' ORDER BY code DESC
END ELSE IF (@vstatus='SupplyActive')BEGIN
SELECT DISTINCT A.sup_id AS code, A.sup_name AS title FROM tblSupplies AS A WHERE A.branchcode=@vBranchcode and A.active='1' END ELSE IF (@vstatus='ProductActive')BEGIN
SELECT DISTINCT A.pro_code AS CODE , A.pro_name AS title from tblProducts AS A WHERE A.branchcode=@vBranchcode and A.active='1' ORDER BY A.pro_code
END ELSE IF (@vstatus='PaymentOption')BEGIN
SELECT A.line_id AS CODE, (A.title+ ' '+ ISNULL(RIGHT(a.account,4),'') ) as title from [tblpaymentlines] as a WHERE A.branchcode=@vBranchcode and A.active='1' ORDER BY A.line_id END ELSE IF (@vstatus='PaymentAccount')BEGIN SELECT A.account from [tblpaymentlines] as a WHERE A.branchcode=@vBranchcode and A.active='1' and a.line_id=@vCon1 ORDER BY A.line_id END;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_auth_paymentvoucher] @vCMD nvarchar(25), @vBranchcode nvarchar(25), @vts_ID nvarchar(25), @vInputter nvarchar(150)='' AS BEGIN DECLARE @vbatch_id NVARCHAR(25) DECLARE @vts_num NVARCHAR(25)

from [tblunapaymentsub] as a where a.branchcode=@vBranchcode and a.[pv_id]=@vts_ID
INSERT INTO [dbo].[tbl_payment_signature] ([sysdocnum] ,[branchcode] ,[pv_id] ,[rs_id] ,[responder] ,[position] ,[rs_date] ,[inputter] ,[created_at])
select distinct [sysdocnum] ,[branchcode] ,[pv_id] ,[rs_id] ,[responder] ,[position] ,[rs_date] ,[inputter] ,[created_at] from tbluna_payment_signature as a where a.branchcode=@vBranchcode and a.[pv_id]=@vts_ID

UPDATE a SET a.amount = b.total_amount FROM tbl_account_payable AS a INNER JOIN ( SELECT ap_id, branchcode, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM tbl_account_payable_sub WHERE branchcode = @vBranchcode AND ap_id = @vts_ID GROUP BY ap_id, branchcode ) AS b ON a.ap_id = b.ap_id AND a.branchcode = b.branchcode

END ELSE IF(@vCMD='r_paymentvoucher')BEGIN EXEC proc_delete_trans @vCMD,@vBranchcode,@vts_ID,@vInputter END ELSE IF(@vCMD='r_AccountPayable')BEGIN EXEC proc_delete_trans @vCMD,@vBranchcode,@vts_ID,@vInputter END ELSE IF(@vCMD='del_acc_paid')BEGIN EXEC proc_delete_trans @vCMD,@vBranchcode,@vts_ID,@vInputter END

ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[fun_amount]( @vstatus NVARCHAR(20), @vbranchcode NVARCHAR(10), @vtracode1 NVARCHAR(20)='', @vtracode2 NVARCHAR(20)='' ) RETURNS MONEY AS BEGIN DECLARE @vAmount MONEY DECLARE @vTotalAmount MONEY DECLARE @vPaidAmount MONEY if(@vstatus='cost')begin set @vAmount= isnull((SELECT A.cost FROM tblProducts AS A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.pro_code=@vtracode1 AND A.active='1'),0) end else if(@vstatus='price')begin set @vAmount= isnull((SELECT A.unitprice FROM tblProducts AS A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.pro_code=@vtracode1 AND A.active='1'),0) end else if(@vstatus='discount')begin set @vAmount= isnull((SELECT A.discount FROM tblProducts AS A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.pro_code=@vtracode1 AND A.active='1'),0) end else if(@vstatus='t_amount')begin set @vAmount= isnull((SELECT SUM(A.AMOUNT) FROM tblunaStockOuts AS A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.rcp_num=@vtracode1),0)
end else if(@vstatus='pos_cost')begin set @vAmount= isnull((SELECT A.cost FROM tblProducts AS A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.pro_code=@vtracode1 AND A.active='1'),0)
end else if(@vstatus='acc_paid')begin set @vTotalAmount= isnull((SELECT sum(isnull( A.amount,0)) FROM tbl_account_payable_sub AS A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.ap_id=@vtracode1),0) set @vPaidAmount= isnull((SELECT sum(isnull( A.amount,0)) FROM tbl_account_payable_paid AS A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.ap_id=@vtracode1),0)
set @vAmount=@vTotalAmount-@vPaidAmount
end
RETURN isnull(@vAmount,0) END

ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_next_id] @vbranchcode NVARCHAR(10), @vcolumns NVARCHAR(50), @vlevels NVARCHAR(50), @vcode NVARCHAR(100) OUTPUT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
DECLARE @vsequence INT DECLARE @retval INT DECLARE @vMinlength INT = 4 DECLARE @vMaxlength INT = 6
DECLARE @vYear NVARCHAR(4) DECLARE @vMonth NVARCHAR(2) DECLARE @vDay NVARCHAR(2)
SET @vcolumns = UPPER(ISNULL(@vcolumns,''))
SET @vYear = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), DATEPART(YEAR, GETDATE())) SET @vMonth = RIGHT('0' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2), DATEPART(MONTH, GETDATE())),2) SET @vDay = RIGHT('0' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2), DATEPART(DAY, GETDATE())),2)
-------------------------------------------------- -- Ensure record exists -------------------------------------------------- IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tblrecordid WHERE branchcode = @vbranchcode AND convalue = @vcolumns ) BEGIN INSERT INTO tblrecordid (branchcode,convalue,recordid,description) VALUES (@vbranchcode,@vcolumns,0,@vcolumns) END
-------------------------------------------------- -- Get sequence -------------------------------------------------- SELECT @retval = ISNULL(MAX(recordid),0) FROM tblrecordid WHERE branchcode=@vbranchcode AND convalue=@vcolumns
SET @vsequence = @retval + 1
-------------------------------------------------- -- Update sequence -------------------------------------------------- UPDATE tblrecordid SET recordid=@vsequence WHERE branchcode=@vbranchcode AND convalue=@vcolumns
-------------------------------------------------- -- Generate Code --------------------------------------------------
IF (@vlevels='branchcode') SET @vcode = REPLICATE('0',4-LEN(@vsequence)) + CAST(@vsequence AS NVARCHAR)
ELSE IF (@vlevels='DraftInvoice') SET @vcode = 'DR' + @vYear + @vMonth + '-' + REPLICATE('0',5-LEN(@vsequence)) + CAST(@vsequence AS NVARCHAR)
ELSE IF (@vlevels='INVOICE') SET @vcode = 'TIHVB' + @vYear + '-' + REPLICATE('0',5-LEN(@vsequence)) + CAST(@vsequence AS NVARCHAR)
ELSE IF (@vlevels='COMMERCIAL') SET @vcode = 'CIHVB' + @vYear + '-' + REPLICATE('0',5-LEN(@vsequence)) + CAST(@vsequence AS NVARCHAR)
ELSE IF (@vlevels='INVOICE_RE') SET @vcode = 'RTIHVB' + @vYear + '-' + REPLICATE('0',5-LEN(@vsequence)) + CAST(@vsequence AS NVARCHAR)
ELSE IF (@vlevels='COMMERCIAL_RE') SET @vcode = 'RCIHVB' + @vYear + '-' + REPLICATE('0',5-LEN(@vsequence)) + CAST(@vsequence AS NVARCHAR)
ELSE IF (@vlevels='RETURN_IN') SET @vcode = 'CNHVB' + @vYear + '-' + REPLICATE('0',5-LEN(@vsequence)) + CAST(@vsequence AS NVARCHAR)
ELSE IF (@vlevels='paymentvoucher') SET @vcode = @vcolumns + '-'+ @vYear + '-' + REPLICATE('0',5-LEN(@vsequence)) + CAST(@vsequence AS NVARCHAR)
ELSE IF (@vlevels='0') SET @vcode = ISNULL(@vcolumns,'NONE') + @vYear + @vMonth + '-' + REPLICATE('0',@vMinlength-LEN(@vsequence)) + CAST(@vsequence AS NVARCHAR)
ELSE IF (@vlevels='1') SET @vcode = @vbranchcode + '-' + REPLICATE('0',@vMinlength-LEN(@vsequence)) + CAST(@vsequence AS NVARCHAR)
ELSE IF (@vlevels='2') SET @vcode = ISNULL(LEFT(@vcolumns,3),'N') + REPLICATE('0',@vMinlength-LEN(@vsequence)) + CAST(@vsequence AS NVARCHAR)
ELSE IF (@vlevels='3') SET @vcode = ISNULL(LEFT(@vcolumns,1),'N') + REPLICATE('0',@vMinlength-LEN(@vsequence)) + CAST(@vsequence AS NVARCHAR)
ELSE IF (@vlevels='9') SET @vcode = @vYear + @vMonth + @vDay + '-' + REPLICATE('0',@vMaxlength-LEN(@vsequence)) + CAST(@vsequence AS NVARCHAR)
ELSE IF (@vlevels='BTC') SET @vcode = ISNULL(@vcolumns,'NONE') + @vYear + @vMonth + '-' + REPLICATE('0',@vMinlength-LEN(@vsequence)) + CAST(@vsequence AS NVARCHAR)
END

ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[fun_product_line]( @vstatus NVARCHAR(20), @vbranchcode NVARCHAR(10), @vpro_code NVARCHAR(25) ) RETURNS nvarchar(50) AS BEGIN DECLARE @vReturn nvarchar(50) if(@vstatus='pack')begin set @vReturn= isnull((select top 1 b.line_name from tblProducts as a inner join tblLines as b on a.branchcode=b.branchcode and a.pack_id=b.line_id WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND a.pro_code=@vpro_code),'None') end else if(@vstatus='payment')begin set @vReturn= isnull((select top 1 case when b.account is null then b.title else (b.title + ' : ' + b.account) end as title from tblunapaymentvoucher as a inner join tblpaymentlines as b on a.branchcode=b.branchcode and a.pay_option=b.line_id WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND a.pv_id=@vpro_code),'None') end
RETURN isnull(@vReturn,'None') END

ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_auth_pos] @vCMD nvarchar(25), @vBranchcode nvarchar(25), @vPOS_ID nvarchar(25), @vInputter nvarchar(150)='', @vCus_ID nvarchar(150)=''
AS BEGIN DECLARE @vbatch_id NVARCHAR(25) DECLARE @vrcp_num NVARCHAR(25)
IF(@vCMD='POS_Auth')BEGIN
delete a from [tblInvoices] as a where a.branchcode=@vBranchcode and a.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID delete a from [tblStockOuts] as a where a.branchcode=@vBranchcode and a.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID
INSERT INTO [tblInvoices] ([rcp_num] ,[branchcode] ,[cus_id] ,[rcp_date] ,[currency] ,[exchangrate] ,[amount] ,[draft] ,[flag] ,[referent] ,[inputter] ,[create_at] ,[Editing] ,[authoriser] ,[authorize_at]) select [rcp_num] ,[branchcode] ,[cus_id] ,[rcp_date] ,[currency] ,[exchangrate] ,[amount] ,[draft] ,[flag] ,[referent] ,[inputter] ,[create_at] ,[Editing] ,@vInputter ,GETDATE() from tblunaInvoices as a where a.branchcode=@vBranchcode and a.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID
INSERT INTO [tblStockOuts] ([sysdocnum] ,[rcp_num] ,[branchcode] ,[sto_id] ,[pro_code] ,[barcode] ,[qty] ,[cost] ,[unitprice] ,[discount] ,[amount] ,[batch_id] ,[exp_date] ,[create_at] )
SELECT [sysdocnum] ,[rcp_num] ,[branchcode] ,[sto_id] ,[pro_code] ,[barcode] ,[qty] ,[cost] ,[unitprice] ,[discount] ,[amount] ,[batch_id] ,[exp_date] ,[create_at] FROM [dbo].[tblunaStockOuts] as a where a.branchcode=@vBranchcode and a.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID
IF EXISTS( SELECT A.rcp_num FROM tblInvoices AS A WHERE a.branchcode=@vBranchcode and a.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID AND flag IN ('0','1'))BEGIN exec proc_submit_transaction 'pos',@vBranchcode,@vPOS_ID,@vInputter
END ELSE IF EXISTS( SELECT A.rcp_num FROM tblInvoices AS A WHERE a.branchcode=@vBranchcode and a.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID AND flag IN ('2','3'))BEGIN exec proc_submit_transaction 're-pos',@vBranchcode,@vPOS_ID,@vInputter
END
delete a from [tblunaInvoices] as a where a.branchcode=@vBranchcode and a.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID delete a from [tblunaStockOuts] as a where a.branchcode=@vBranchcode and a.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID
END ELSE IF(@vCMD='POS_Reject')BEGIN EXEC proc_delete_trans @vCMD,@vBranchcode,@vPOS_ID,@vInputter
END ELSE IF(@vCMD='del_draf_pos') AND EXISTS ( SELECT A.rcp_num FROM tblunaInvoices AS A WHERE a.branchcode=@vBranchcode and a.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID)BEGIN EXEC proc_delete_trans @vCMD,@vBranchcode,@vPOS_ID,@vInputter END IF (@vCMD='rcp_commit')begin
EXEC proc_delete_trans @vCMD,@vBranchcode,@vPOS_ID,@vInputter
IF EXISTS (SELECT A.rcp_num FROM tblunaInvoices AS A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID AND A.draft='1')BEGIN
IF EXISTS (SELECT A.rcp_num FROM tblunaInvoices AS A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID AND A.draft='1' AND A.flag='0')BEGIN EXEC proc_next_id @vbranchcode,'INVOICE','INVOICE',@vrcp_num OUTPUT ; END
IF EXISTS (SELECT A.rcp_num FROM tblunaInvoices AS A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID AND A.draft='1' AND A.flag='1')BEGIN EXEC proc_next_id @vbranchcode,'COMMERCIAL','COMMERCIAL',@vrcp_num OUTPUT ; END
update A SET A.draft=0 from tblunaInvoices as A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID update A SET A.rcp_num=@vrcp_num, Editing=GETDATE(),a.cus_id=@vCus_ID from tblunaInvoices as A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID update A SET A.rcp_num=@vrcp_num from tblunaStockOuts as A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID
SET @vPOS_ID =@vrcp_num END ELSE BEGIN update A SET Editing=GETDATE(),a.cus_id=@vCus_ID from tblunaInvoices as A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID END END IF (@vCMD='rcp_commit_re')begin
IF EXISTS (SELECT A.rcp_num FROM tblunaInvoices AS A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID AND A.draft='1' )BEGIN
IF EXISTS (SELECT A.rcp_num FROM tblunaInvoices AS A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID AND A.draft='1' AND A.flag='2')BEGIN EXEC proc_next_id @vbranchcode,'RETURN_IN','RETURN_IN',@vrcp_num OUTPUT ; END
IF EXISTS (SELECT A.rcp_num FROM tblunaInvoices AS A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID AND A.draft='1' AND A.flag='3')BEGIN EXEC proc_next_id @vbranchcode,'RETURN_IN','RETURN_IN',@vrcp_num OUTPUT ; END
update A SET A.draft=0 ,A.rcp_num=@vrcp_num, Editing=GETDATE() , a.inputter=@vInputter from tblunaInvoices as A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID update A SET A.rcp_num=@vrcp_num from tblunaStockOuts as A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID
SET @vPOS_ID =@vrcp_num
END ELSE BEGIN update A SET Editing=GETDATE(), a.inputter=@vInputter from tblunaInvoices as A WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND A.rcp_num=@vPOS_ID END
END
select @vPOS_ID as TRANCODE
-- proc_auth_pos N'rcp_commit',N'0101',N'0101-0015',N'reanit',N'C0002'
END

ALTER procedure [dbo].[proc_get_sql] @vstatus nvarchar(50), @vbranchcode nvarchar(10), @vcode1 nvarchar(50)='', @vcode2 nvarchar(50)='' as begin
if(@vcode1='0000')begin set @vcode1='%' end
if (@vstatus='show_customer') begin
select distinct a.cus_id , a.cus_name, a.phone, a.remark, a.address, a.gender, isnull(a.address,'') as address, convert(nvarchar(50),a.active) as active from tblCustomers as a inner join sysconstants as b on a.active=b.con_id and b.con_line='active' where a.branchcode=@vbranchcode and a.cus_id=@vcode1 order by a.cus_id
end else if (@vstatus='rePrint_POS') begin
select a.rcp_num, b.cus_name, a.flag, a.inputter, convert(nvarchar(250),('Invoice : '+a.rcp_num+' , Customer : '+ b.cus_name)) as info from tblInvoices as a inner join tblCustomers as b on a.branchcode=b.BranchCode and a.cus_id=b.cus_id where a.branchcode=@vbranchcode and a.rcp_num=@vcode1 end else if (@vstatus='check_user_exists') begin
select * from sys_user_logins as a where a.user_login=@vcode1
end if (@vstatus='show_product') begin
select a.pro_code, a.barcode, a.line_id, a.mol_id, a.pack_id, a.pro_name, convert(nvarchar(50),a.active) as active, a.cost, a.cost_tax, a.unitprice, a.discount, a.remark, a.inputter, a.create_at from tblProducts as a where a.BranchCode=@vbranchcode and a.pro_code=@vcode1
end if (@vstatus='show_po_history') begin select distinct a.po_id, a.sup_id, b.sup_name, b.phone, c.sysdocnum, (ISNULL(a.po_id,'')+ ': '+ b.sup_name +' :'+ isnull(b.phone,'') ) as info from tblunaPurchaseOrder as a inner join tblSupplies as b on a.branchcode=b.branchcode and a.sup_id=b.sup_id left join tblunaPurchaseOrderDetails as c on a.branchcode = c.branchcode and a.po_id=c.po_id where a.branchcode=@vbranchcode and a.po_id=@vcode1
end else if (@vstatus='load_profile') begin select a.pro_id as id, a.pro_name as name from tbl_user_profile as a where a.Active='1' order by a.pro_id
end if (@vstatus='show_po_una_list') begin
select distinct a.po_id, a.branchcode, a.inputter, b.sysdocnum, b.pro_code, p.pro_name, p.barcode, isnull(b.qty,0) as qty, isnull(b.cost,0) as cost, isnull(b.oth_cost,0) as oth_cost, isnull(b.discount,0) as discount, b.amount, b.oth_amount, b.sto_id, convert(nvarchar(50),b.exp_date,103) as exp_date from tblunaPurchaseOrder as a inner join tblunaPurchaseOrderDetails as b on a.po_id=b.po_id and a.branchcode=b.branchcode inner join tblProducts as p on b.pro_code=p.pro_code and b.branchcode=p.branchcode where a.branchcode=@vbranchcode and a.po_id=@vcode1 order by a.po_id,b.sysdocnum
end if (@vstatus='UNA_PO_Edit_Expired') begin select top 1 a.exp_date from tblunaPurchaseOrderDetails as a where a.branchcode= @vbranchcode and a.sysdocnum=@vcode1
end if (@vstatus='UNA_PO_Sub') begin select distinct a.po_id, s.sup_name, a.remark, a.inputter, b.sysdocnum, p.pro_name, isnull(b.qty,0) as qty, isnull(b.cost,0) as cost, isnull(b.oth_cost,0) as oth_cost, isnull(b.discount,0) as discount, b.amount, dbo.fun_stock('stock_name',a.branchcode,b.sto_id) as stock_name, convert(nvarchar(50),b.exp_date,103) as exp_date from tblunaPurchaseOrder as a inner join tblunaPurchaseOrderDetails as b on a.po_id=b.po_id and a.branchcode=b.branchcode inner join tblProducts as p on b.pro_code=p.pro_code and b.branchcode=p.branchcode inner join tblSupplies as s on a.branchcode=s.branchcode and a.sup_id=s.sup_id where a.branchcode=@vbranchcode and a.po_id=@vcode1 order by a.po_id,b.sysdocnum
end else if (@vstatus='show_supply') begin
select distinct a.sup_id , a.sup_name, a.phone, isnull(a.remark,'') as remark, isnull(a.address,'') as address, convert(nvarchar(50),a.active) as active from tblSupplies as a inner join sysconstants as b on a.active=b.con_id and b.con_line='active' where a.branchcode=@vbranchcode and a.sup_id=@vcode1 order by a.sup_id
end else if (@vstatus='show_type_line') begin
select a.line_id, a.line_name, a.line, convert(nvarchar(50),a.active) as active from tblLines as a where a.branchcode=@vbranchcode and a.line_id=@vcode1
end else if (@vstatus='load_user_by_profile') begin
select a.user_id, a.profile_id, a.user_login, a.inputter, b.pro_name, case when a.active=1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end status from sys_user_logins as a inner join tbl_user_profile as b on a.profile_id=b.pro_id where a.branchcode=@vbranchcode and a.profile_id like @vcode1
end else if (@vstatus='get_batch_id') begin
SELECT A.rcp_num, A.branchcode, B.pro_code, P.pro_name, B.sysdocnum, b.qty INTO #tmpStockouts FROM tblunaInvoices AS A INNER JOIN tblunaStockOuts AS B ON A.BranchCode=B.BranchCode AND A.rcp_num=B.rcp_num INNER JOIN tblProducts AS P ON B.BranchCode=P.BranchCode AND B.pro_code=P.pro_code WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND b.sysdocnum=@vcode1
select a.pro_code, a.pro_name, b.stock_code, b.batch_id, sum(b.qty) as qty INTO #tmpStockIN from #tmpStockouts as a inner join TblTransactions as b on a.branchcode=b.BranchCode and a.pro_code=b.pro_code where b.BranchCode=@vbranchcode and b.stock_code=@vcode2 group by a.pro_code, a.pro_name, b.stock_code, b.batch_id
SELECT DISTINCT A.batch_id AS code, A.batch_id AS title FROM #tmpStockIN AS A where a.qty>0
end
end

ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_get_sql_pos] @vstatus NVARCHAR(50), @vbranchcode NVARCHAR(10), @vcode1 NVARCHAR(50), @vflag NVARCHAR(50) = '' AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
----------------------------- -- POS PRODUCT ----------------------------- IF @vstatus = 'pos_product' BEGIN SELECT '' AS code, 'choose option' AS name UNION ALL SELECT pro_code, pro_name FROM tblProducts WHERE BranchCode = @vbranchcode AND active = '1' AND CONVERT(date, ISNULL(update_at, GETDATE())) >= dbo.fun_use_date() ORDER BY code; RETURN END
----------------------------- -- VIEW PURCHASE ORDER ----------------------------- ELSE IF @vstatus = 'view_po' BEGIN SELECT po_id, branchcode, sup_id, exc_id, po_date, remark, inputter, create_at FROM tblunaPurchaseOrder WHERE branchcode = @vbranchcode AND po_id = @vcode1; RETURN END
----------------------------- -- POS CUSTOMER ----------------------------- ELSE IF @vstatus = 'pos_customer' BEGIN SELECT DISTINCT cus_id AS code, cus_name AS name FROM tblCustomers WHERE BranchCode = @vbranchcode AND active = '1' ORDER BY cus_id; RETURN END
----------------------------- -- STOCK MENU ----------------------------- ELSE IF @vstatus = 'stock_menu' BEGIN SELECT '' AS code, '' AS name UNION ALL SELECT sto_id, sto_name FROM tblStockMenu WHERE branchcode = @vbranchcode AND active = '1'; RETURN END
----------------------------- -- POS UNA LIST ----------------------------- ELSE IF @vstatus = 'pos_una_list' BEGIN SELECT i.rcp_num, i.cus_id, i.rcp_date, ISNULL(s.pro_code,'') AS pro_code, ISNULL(s.barcode,'') AS barcode, ISNULL(p.pro_name,'') AS pro_name, i.exchangrate, ISNULL(s.sysdocnum,'') AS sysdocnum, ISNULL(s.sto_id,'') AS sto_id, ISNULL(s.cost,0) AS cost, ISNULL(s.unitprice,0) AS unitprice, ISNULL(s.discount,0) AS discount, ISNULL(s.qty,0) AS qty, ISNULL(s.amount,0) AS amount, i.inputter, ISNULL(s.batch_id,'') AS batch_id FROM tblunaInvoices i LEFT JOIN tblunaStockOuts s ON i.BranchCode = s.BranchCode AND i.rcp_num = s.rcp_num LEFT JOIN tblProducts p ON s.BranchCode = p.BranchCode AND s.pro_code = p.pro_code WHERE i.BranchCode = @vbranchcode AND i.rcp_num = @vcode1 ORDER BY s.create_at; RETURN END
----------------------------- -- POS BATCH ID ----------------------------- ELSE IF @vstatus = 'pos_batchID' BEGIN SELECT TOP 1 i.rcp_num, i.cus_id, i.rcp_date, s.pro_code, s.barcode, p.pro_name, i.exchangrate, s.sysdocnum, s.sto_id, s.cost, s.unitprice, s.discount, s.qty, s.amount, i.inputter, ISNULL(s.batch_id,'') AS batch_id FROM tblunaInvoices i INNER JOIN tblunaStockOuts s ON i.BranchCode = s.BranchCode AND i.rcp_num = s.rcp_num INNER JOIN tblProducts p ON s.BranchCode = p.BranchCode AND s.pro_code = p.pro_code WHERE i.BranchCode = @vbranchcode AND s.sysdocnum = @vcode1; RETURN END
----------------------------- -- LOAD BATCH ID ----------------------------- ELSE IF @vstatus = 'load_batch_id' BEGIN SELECT i.rcp_num, i.branchcode, s.pro_code, p.pro_name, s.sysdocnum, s.sto_id, s.qty INTO #tmpStockouts FROM tblunaInvoices i INNER JOIN tblunaStockOuts s ON i.BranchCode = s.BranchCode AND i.rcp_num = s.rcp_num INNER JOIN tblProducts p ON s.BranchCode = p.BranchCode AND s.pro_code = p.pro_code WHERE i.BranchCode = @vbranchcode AND s.sysdocnum = @vcode1;
SELECT so.pro_code, so.pro_name, so.sto_id, t.batch_id, SUM(t.qty_balance) AS qty INTO #tmpStockIN FROM #tmpStockouts so INNER JOIN TblTransactions t ON so.branchcode = t.BranchCode AND so.sto_id = t.stock_code AND so.pro_code = t.pro_code GROUP BY so.pro_code, so.pro_name, so.sto_id, t.batch_id;
SELECT DISTINCT batch_id AS code, batch_id AS title FROM #tmpStockIN; RETURN END
----------------------------- -- RCP UNA LIST ----------------------------- ELSE IF @vstatus = 'rcp_una_list' BEGIN SELECT i.rcp_num, i.inputter, i.cus_id, c.cus_name, i.create_at, CASE WHEN i.flag IN ('0','1') THEN 'POS' ELSE 'Return' END AS status FROM tblunaInvoices i INNER JOIN tblCustomers c ON i.branchcode = c.BranchCode AND i.cus_id = c.cus_id WHERE i.branchcode = @vbranchcode AND (i.rcp_num LIKE '%' + @vcode1 + '%' OR c.cus_name LIKE '%' + @vcode1 + '%' OR dbo.ConvertUnicode(c.cus_name) LIKE '%' + dbo.ConvertUnicode(@vcode1) + '%') AND i.Editing IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.create_at DESC; RETURN END
----------------------------- -- pv_una_info ----------------------------- ELSE IF @vstatus = 'pv_una_info' BEGIN
select a.pv_id, a.branchcode, a.inputter, a.pay_date, a.pay_to, a.pay_option, a.receipt, a.invoice, a.created_at from tblunapaymentvoucher as a where a.branchcode=@vbranchcode and a.pv_id=@vcode1 order by a.created_at
RETURN END
ELSE IF @vstatus = 'pv_una_payment' BEGIN
select a.pv_id, a.branchcode, a.inputter, a.pay_date, a.pay_to, b.title as pay_option, a.receipt, a.invoice, a.created_at from tblunapaymentvoucher as a inner join tblpaymentlines as b on a.branchcode=b.branchcode and a.pay_option=b.line_id where a.branchcode=@vbranchcode and a.draft=1 and ( a.pv_id like '%'+ @vcode1+'%' or a.pay_to like '%'+ @vcode1+'%' or a.receipt like '%'+ @vcode1+'%') order by a.created_at
RETURN END
ELSE IF @vstatus = 'accounts_payable' BEGIN
select a.ap_id, a.branchcode, a.inputter, a.ap_date, a.supply_id, a.invoice, a.remark, a.created_at, c.sup_name from tbluna_account_payable as a inner join tbluna_account_payable_sub as b on a.branchcode=b.branchcode and a.ap_id=b.ap_id left join tblSupplies as c on a.branchcode=c.branchcode and a.supply_id=c.sup_id where a.branchcode=@vbranchcode and a.ap_id=@vcode1 order by a.created_at
RETURN END ELSE IF @vstatus = 'get_accounts_payable' BEGIN select a.ap_id, a.branchcode, a.ap_date, a.invoice, (c.sup_name + ' , invoice : '+ a.invoice ) AS info, dbo.fun_amount('acc_paid',a.branchcode,a.ap_id,'') as Balance, isnull(b.amount,0) as amount, isnull(b.remark,'') as remark, isnull(b.paiddate,GETDATE()) as paiddate, b.sysdoc from tbl_account_payable as a left join tbl_account_payable_paid as b on a.branchcode=b.branchcode and a.ap_id=b.ap_id left join tblSupplies as c on a.branchcode=c.branchcode and a.supply_id=c.sup_id where a.branchcode=@vbranchcode and a.ap_id=@vcode1 order by b.sysdoc
RETURN
END if (@vstatus='rcp_una_list_details') begin
SELECT distinct A.rcp_num, B.pro_code, P.pro_name, B.sysdocnum, B.sto_id, dbo.fun_stock('stock_name',b.branchcode,b.sto_id) as sto_name, B.cost, B.unitprice, B.discount, B.qty, B.amount, A.inputter, case when b.batch_id is null then '' else b.batch_id end as batch_id , b.create_at FROM tblunaInvoices AS A INNER JOIN tblunaStockOuts AS B ON A.BranchCode=B.BranchCode AND A.rcp_num=B.rcp_num INNER JOIN tblProducts AS P ON B.BranchCode=P.BranchCode AND B.pro_code=P.pro_code WHERE A.BranchCode=@vbranchcode AND a.rcp_num=@vcode1 order by b.create_at END ELSE IF @vstatus = 'accounts_payable_history' BEGIN select a.ap_id, a.branchcode, a.ap_date, a.invoice, (c.sup_name + ' , invoice : '+ a.invoice ) AS info, dbo.fun_amount('acc_paid',a.branchcode,a.ap_id,'') as Balance, isnull(b.amount,0) as amount, isnull(b.remark,'') as remark, isnull(b.paiddate,GETDATE()) as paiddate, b.sysdoc from tbl_account_payable as a inner join tbl_account_payable_paid as b on a.branchcode=b.branchcode and a.ap_id=b.ap_id left join tblSupplies as c on a.branchcode=c.branchcode and a.supply_id=c.sup_id where a.branchcode=@vbranchcode and a.ap_id=@vcode1 order by b.sysdoc
RETURN
END
END

END ELSE IF (@vstatus='POS_D')BEGIN DELETE a from tblunaStockOuts as a where a.branchcode= @vbranchcode and a.sysdocnum=@vTran_ID
END ELSE IF (@vstatus='ST_D')BEGIN DELETE a from tblunastocktransferdetails as a where a.branchcode= @vbranchcode and a.sysdocnum=@vTran_ID
END ; select @vTran_ID as trancode
END

select a.ap_id, a.branchcode, a.sup_name, b.sysdocnum, b.amount, b.[description] into #tmp_ap_details from #tmp_account_payable as a inner join tbl_account_payable_sub as b on a.branchcode=b.branchcode and a.ap_id=b.ap_id

select distinct a.pro_code, a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, b.batch_id, SUM(b.qty) as qty into #tmpOpening FROM #tmpActive AS A INNER JOIN TblTransactions AS B ON A.BranchCode=B.BranchCode AND A.pro_code=B.pro_code AND A.stock_code=B.stock_code and b.trans_date<@vdate_from group by a.pro_code, a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, b.batch_id HAVING SUM(b.qty)<>0

select distinct a.pro_code, a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, a.batch_id, a.qty, b.cost, b.oth_cost, a.trans_date, a.trans_code, b.exp_date into #tmpPO from #tmpTransactions as a inner join tblPurchaseOrderDetails as b on a.BranchCode=b.branchcode and a.pro_code=b.pro_code and a.stock_code=b.sto_id and a.batch_id=b.batch_id and a.referent=b.po_id where a.trans_code in ('01')
select distinct a.pro_code, a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, a.batch_id, abs(a.qty) as qty, b.cost, (abs(a.qty)*b.cost) as t_cost, b.amount, (abs(a.qty)*b.amount) as t_amount, a.trans_date, a.trans_code, a.exp_date, a.referent into #tmpSale from #tmpTransactions as a left join tblStockOuts as b on a.BranchCode=b.branchcode and a.pro_code=b.pro_code and a.stock_code=b.sto_id and a.batch_id=b.batch_id and a.referent=b.rcp_num where a.trans_code in ('02')

select a.pro_code, a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, a.batch_id, sum(a.qty) as qty into #tmpOther from #tmpTransactions as a where a.trans_code not in ('01','02') and a.pro_code like @vpro_id +'%' and a.stock_code like @vsto_id+'%' group by a.pro_code, a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, a.batch_id
--- Merge all transaction and generate report create table #tmpMerge (pro_code nvarchar(25) , branchcode nvarchar(25) , stock_code nvarchar(25)) insert into #tmpMerge (pro_code,branchcode,stock_code) select distinct pro_code,branchcode,stock_code from #tmpOpening as a insert into #tmpMerge (pro_code,branchcode,stock_code) select distinct pro_code,branchcode,stock_code from #tmpPO as a insert into #tmpMerge (pro_code,branchcode,stock_code) select distinct pro_code,branchcode,stock_code from #tmpSale as a insert into #tmpMerge (pro_code,branchcode,stock_code) select distinct pro_code,branchcode,stock_code from #tmpOther as a
select distinct a.pro_code, a.branchcode, a.stock_code, convert(int,0) AS qty_opening, convert(int,0) AS qty_po, convert(money,0) AS cost_po, convert(money,0) AS oth_cost_po, convert(money,0) AS qty_sale, convert(money,0) AS t_cost_sale, convert(money,0) AS t_amount_sale, convert(money,0) AS other_qty, convert(money,0) AS qty_ending, convert(money,0) AS cost_ending, convert(nvarchar(50),'') AS STATUS into #tmpTransBatch from #tmpMerge as a
select distinct a.pro_code, a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, b.batch_id, Max(isnull(c.cost,0)) as cost, SUM(b.qty) as qty into #tmpEnding FROM #tmpTransBatch AS A INNER JOIN TblTransactions AS B ON A.BranchCode=B.BranchCode AND A.pro_code=B.pro_code AND A.stock_code=B.stock_code and b.trans_date<=@vdate_to LEFT JOIN tblcost AS C ON C.BranchCode=B.BranchCode AND C.pro_code=B.pro_code AND C.stock_code=B.stock_code and C.batch_id=b.batch_id group by a.pro_code, a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, b.batch_id HAVING SUM(b.qty)<>0
select distinct a.pro_code, a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, a.cost, a.qty, (a.cost*a.qty) as t_cost into #tmpTotalEnding FROM #tmpEnding AS A order by a.pro_code, a.BranchCode, a.stock_code
select distinct a.pro_code, a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, SUM(a.qty) as qty, SUM(a.t_cost) as t_cost into #tmpEndingSumamry FROM #tmpTotalEnding AS A group by a.pro_code, a.BranchCode, a.stock_code
select a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, a.pro_code, sum(a.qty) as qty into #tmpOpeningSummary from #tmpOpening as a group by a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, a.pro_code
select a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, a.pro_code, sum(a.qty) as qty into #tmpOtherSumamry from #tmpOther as a group by a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, a.pro_code
select a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, a.pro_code, sum(a.qty) as qty, sum(a.cost) as cost, sum(a.oth_cost) as oth_cost into #tmpPOSummary from #tmpPO as a group by a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, a.pro_code
select a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, a.pro_code, sum(a.qty) as qty, sum(a.t_cost) as t_cost, sum(a.t_amount) as t_amount into #tmpSaleSummary from #tmpSale as a group by a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, a.pro_code
update a set a.qty_opening=b.qty from #tmpTransBatch as a inner join #tmpOpeningSummary as b on a.branchcode=b.branchcode and a.stock_code=b.stock_code and a.pro_code=b.pro_code update a set a.qty_po=b.qty,cost_po=b.cost,a.oth_cost_po=b.oth_cost from #tmpTransBatch as a inner join #tmpPOSummary as b on a.branchcode=b.branchcode and a.stock_code=b.stock_code and a.pro_code=b.pro_code update a set a.qty_sale=b.qty,a.t_cost_sale=b.t_cost,a.t_amount_sale=b.t_amount from #tmpTransBatch as a inner join #tmpSaleSummary as b on a.branchcode=b.branchcode and a.stock_code=b.stock_code and a.pro_code=b.pro_code update a set a.other_qty=b.qty from #tmpTransBatch as a inner join #tmpOtherSumamry as b on a.branchcode=b.branchcode and a.stock_code=b.stock_code and a.pro_code=b.pro_code update a set a.qty_ending=b.qty , a.cost_ending=b.t_cost from #tmpTransBatch as a inner join #tmpEndingSumamry as b on a.branchcode=b.branchcode and a.stock_code=b.stock_code and a.pro_code=b.pro_code

--- rpt_product_details N'0101',N'%',N'%',N'%',N'%',N'%',N'%',N'2025/12/01',N'2025/12/29'
select distinct a.pro_code, a.pro_name, a.BranchCode, a.stock_code, a.mol_name, a.pack_name, b.qty_opening, b.qty_po, b.cost_po, (b.qty_po*b.cost_po) as t_cost_po, b.oth_cost_po, (b.qty_po*b.oth_cost_po) as t_oth_cost_po, b.qty_sale, b.t_cost_sale, b.t_amount_sale, b.other_qty, b.qty_ending, b.cost_ending INTO #tmpFinal from #tmpActiveDetails as a INNER JOIN #tmpTransBatch AS B ON A.BranchCode=B.branchcode AND A.stock_code=B.stock_code AND A.pro_code=B.pro_code
select distinct a.pro_code, a.pro_name, b.sto_name, a.mol_name, a.pack_name, sum(a.qty_opening) as qty_opening, sum(a.qty_po) as qty_po, sum(a.cost_po) as cost_po, sum(a.oth_cost_po) as oth_cost_po, sum(a.t_oth_cost_po) as t_oth_cost_po, sum(a.qty_sale) as qty_sale, sum(a.t_cost_sale) as t_cost_sale, sum(a.t_amount_sale) as t_amount_sale, sum(a.other_qty) as other_qty, sum(a.qty_ending) as qty_ending, sum(isnull(a.cost_ending,0)) as cost_ending from #tmpFinal as a inner join tblStockMenu as b on a.BranchCode=b.branchcode and a.stock_code=b.sto_id group by a.pro_code, a.pro_name, b.sto_name, a.mol_name, a.pack_name order by a.pro_code,b.sto_name

create procedure [dbo].[proc_print_PaymentVoucher] @vstatus nvarchar(50), @vbranchcode nvarchar(10), @vpv_id nvarchar(50) AS BEGIN
IF(@vstatus='una_print')BEGIN
select a.pv_id, a.branchcode, a.pay_date, a.invoice, a.receipt, a.inputter, a.pay_to, b.create_at, b.pay_no, b.pay_des, b.pay_amount, b.sysdocnum, dbo.fun_product_line('payment',a.branchcode,a.pv_id) as option_title from tblunapaymentvoucher AS a inner join tblunapaymentsub as b on a.branchcode=b.branchcode and a.pv_id=b.pv_id where a.branchcode=@vbranchcode and a.pv_id=@vpv_id order by b.sysdocnum END ELSE IF(@vstatus='una_signature')BEGIN
select distinct a.pv_id, a.branchcode, B.responder, B.position, B.rs_date, c.title as rs_title, b.created_at from tblunapaymentvoucher as a inner join tbluna_payment_signature as b on a.branchcode=b.branchcode and a.pv_id=b.pv_id left join tbl_payment_response as c on b.branchcode=c.branchcode and c.rs_id=b.rs_id where a.branchcode=@vbranchcode and a.pv_id=@vpv_id order by b.created_at
END
